name: label
line: the model reads each record of a --prompt label against its definition and gives it a value; the counts and the card fill in
requested_by: `thimble label NAME --prompt ...` (and `--again`) asks for this verb in the session's change feed; the shell runs it on the label's card, beside the session
store: thimble/labels/<name>.json (engine/kernel/labels.py): the answers go back with `thimble label NAME --answers -`
